content.comment_body: Hello everyone, hope you are having a good day! I am using a weekly timer in one of my projects. How can I display the details on the [product_name] display, such as the settings for all three cams and the times set for each? Additionally, is it possible to show weekday names on the [product_name] display, perhaps in a short form like [M T W T F S], and highlight the current active day? Thanks and regards, [user_name].

analysis.insight_summary: The user is looking for improved display features for the weekly timer function on the [product_name]. Specifically, they want clearer visualization of multiple time settings and a dynamic presentation of weekdays, with the ability to highlight active days directly on the device display.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants all timer settings to be viewable and expects to see weekdays displayed as abbreviations, with the current day dynamically highlighted on the [product_name] display.
